anomalies.title: Potential Duplicate Payment Detected: $4,200.00 from BioGenix Labs
anomalies.description: Transaction TXN-2012 was captured 2 minutes after TXN-2007 with identical amount ($4,200.00), identical customer, and identical invoice reference INV-2026-015.
evidence: Invoice INV-2026-015 total was only $8,400 with $4,200 expected balance
anomalies.aiExplanation: Heuristic pattern matches client-side double-submission or automated retry race condition. The second transaction creates an unintended over-collection risk.
anomalies.suggestedResolution: Hold TXN-2012 funds and initiate human review to execute a void or partial refund to BioGenix Labs via PayPal Sandbox.

anomalies.title: Unusually Large Transaction Spike: $45,000.00 from Apex Sovereign Wealth
anomalies.description: Transaction amount ($45,000.00) is 6.8x higher than the 95th percentile historical transaction ($6,600.00) and has no matching customer invoice in the ledger.
evidence: No invoice reference provided in memo
anomalies.aiExplanation: Spike anomaly flags potential unallocated escrow transfer or misrouted institutional payment. Requires manual attribution before clearing to revenue.
anomalies.suggestedResolution: Create manual ledger record or contact Apex Sovereign Wealth to allocate funds to upcoming project contract.

anomalies.title: Currency Discrepancy: Received 3,800.00 EUR for USD 3,800.00 Invoice
anomalies.description: Invoice INV-2026-008 is denominated in USD ($3,800.00), but payment TXN-2013 was settled in EUR (€3,800.00), creating foreign exchange exposure and a valuation surplus.
evidence: Current FX Rate: 1.08 USD/EUR creates an excess collection of ~$304 USD
anomalies.aiExplanation: Payer transferred numerical amount without FX conversion. Invoice cannot be mathematically closed cleanly without adjusting for the FX gain/surplus.
anomalies.suggestedResolution: Record FX gain of $304.00, credit invoice INV-2026-008 as paid in full, and issue credit note or refund for surplus.

anomalies.title: Repeated Failed Payment Attempts (3x) for Horizon Maritime Corp
anomalies.description: Three consecutive payment attempts for $12,400.00 (TXN-2015, TXN-2016, TXN-2017) failed within 25 minutes due to card decline and insufficient balance.
anomalies.aiExplanation: Automated payment gateway failures indicate banking limits or insufficient working capital. Further automatic retries may trigger PayPal fraud blocks on the buyer account.
anomalies.suggestedResolution: Pause automated retries. Trigger account manager notification to send Horizon Maritime wire transfer coordinates.

anomalies.title: Underpayment Discrepancy: $1,400.00 paid on $1,450.00 Invoice ($50 short)
anomalies.description: Quantum Cloud LLC submitted payment TXN-2011 referencing INV-2026-006, but the payment amount was $1,400.00 instead of the billed $1,450.00.
anomalies.aiExplanation: Common withholding fee or bank wire transfer deduction by intermediary institution. The $50 difference leaves the invoice in an open partial state.
anomalies.suggestedResolution: Review if $50 represents acceptable banking wire processing fee to write off, or generate balance-due reminder for $50.00.
